## Design brief
This kernel performs $32 \times 32$ floating-point matrix multiplication ($C = A \times B$). It employs a triple-nested loop structure: outer loops $i$ and $j$ iterate 32 times sequentially, while the innermost $k$ loop sums products over 32 iterations. Matrices reside in global memory accessed via `m_axi` interfaces. `ARRAY_PARTITION` pragmas fully partition A by rows and B by columns into registers, eliminating bank conflicts during the inner loop. The inner $k$-loop is pipelined with `PIPELINE II=1`.

The critical latency bottleneck is the serialized execution of the outer $i$ and $j$ loops. While the inner accumulation is efficient, the design processes only one output element $C[i][j]$ at a time. Total latency approximates $SIZE^3$ cycles. To optimize, applying `DATAFLOW` would enable overlapping execution of independent $(i, j)$ tasks, or `UNROLL` on the outer loops could replicate hardware logic for parallel writes. Currently, the sequential control flow dominates resource utilization, limiting throughput despite the register-based operand access.

## Kernel

#include "matmul.h"

void matmul(const DataT A[SIZE][SIZE], const DataT B[SIZE][SIZE],
            DataT C[SIZE][SIZE]) {
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi port=A offset=slave bundle=gmem0
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi port=B offset=slave bundle=gmem1
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE m_axi port=C offset=slave bundle=gmem2
    #pragma HLS INTERFACE s_axilite port=return bundle=ctrl

    // Partition A by rows - each row accessed in parallel across i iterations
    #pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=A complete dim=1
    
    // Partition B by columns - each column accessed in parallel across j iterations  
    #pragma HLS ARRAY_PARTITION variable=B complete dim=2
    
    // C does not need complete partitioning - use BRAM for storage efficiency
    // Only partition if needed for parallel writes (not required here)

    for (int i = 0; i < SIZE; i++) {
        #pragma HLS UNROLL factor=16
        #pragma HLS LOOP_FLATTEN off
        for (int j = 0; j < SIZE; j++) {
            #pragma HLS UNROLL factor=16
            #pragma HLS LOOP_FLATTEN off
            DataT acc = 0;
            for (int k = 0; k < SIZE; k++) {
                #pragma HLS PIPELINE II=1
                acc += A[i][k] * B[k][j];
            }
            C[i][j] = acc;
        }
    }
}

```
